cut: An instantaneous, abrupt switch between shots with exactly zero temporal duration.
fade: A standard crossfade where the outgoing shot smoothly decreases in opacity while the incoming shot increases.
wipeleft: A linear spatial wipe transitioning across the frame from right to left.
wiperight: A linear spatial wipe transitioning from left to right.
wipeup: A vertical linear wipe progressing from the bottom edge to the top edge.
wipedown: A vertical linear wipe progressing from the top edge to the bottom edge.
slideleft: Translates the incoming shot globally over the outgoing shot from right to left.
slideright: Translates the incoming shot horizontally from left to right.
slideup: Translates the incoming shot vertically upwards from the bottom edge.
slidedown: Translates the incoming shot vertically downwards from the top edge.
circlecrop: Reveals the incoming shot through an expanding circular spatial mask originating from the center.
rectcrop: Reveals the incoming shot through a symmetrically expanding rectangular mask.
distance: Blends pixels temporally based on spatial distance calculations between the two frames.
fadeblack: Fades the outgoing shot completely to a solid black frame before fading into the incoming shot.
fadewhite: Fades the outgoing shot completely to a solid white frame before fading into the incoming shot.
radial: A circular, clock-like rotational sweep mask revealing the incoming shot.
smoothleft: A fluid, smoothed sliding motion of the incoming shot from right to left with easing dynamics.
smoothright: A fluid, smoothed sliding motion from left to right.
smoothup: A fluid, smoothed vertical sliding motion from bottom to top.
smoothdown: A fluid, smoothed vertical sliding motion from top to bottom.
circleopen: Expands a circular aperture from the frame center to transition shots.
circleclose: Contracts a circular aperture to hide the outgoing shot, revealing the underlying incoming shot.
vertopen: Opens a vertical slit outward from the center horizontally to reveal the incoming shot.
vertclose: Closes a vertical slit inward horizontally to transition between shots.
horzopen: Opens a horizontal slit outward vertically from the center.
horzclose: Closes a horizontal slit inward vertically.
dissolve: A specialized pixel-level cross-dissolve that smooths the structural blending of overlapping frames.
pixelize: Applies a highly blocky, pixelation filter that interpolates spatial frequencies between the two shots.
diagtl: A diagonal wipe originating strictly from the top-left corner.
diagtr: A diagonal wipe originating strictly from the top-right corner.
diagbl: A diagonal wipe originating strictly from the bottom-left corner.
diagbr: A diagonal wipe originating strictly from the bottom-right corner.
hlslice: Interleaves horizontal slices sliding inward from the left boundary.
hrslice: Interleaves horizontal slices sliding inward from the right boundary.
vuslice: Interleaves vertical slices sliding inward from the top boundary.
vdslice: Interleaves vertical slices sliding inward from the bottom boundary.
hblur: Applies a heavy horizontal motion blur simultaneously during the temporal crossfade.
fadegrays: Desaturates the outgoing shot to grayscale before temporally fading into the incoming color shot.
wipetl: A corner-based linear wipe progressing towards the top-left.
wipetr: A corner-based linear wipe progressing towards the top-right.
wipebl: A corner-based linear wipe progressing towards the bottom-left.
wipebr: A corner-based linear wipe progressing towards the bottom-right.
squeezeh: Horizontally compresses and squeezes the outgoing shot to reveal the incoming one.
squeezev: Vertically compresses and squeezes the outgoing shot.
zoomin: Scales and zooms into the center of the outgoing shot while fading into the incoming shot.
fadefast: A non-linear, temporally accelerated fade transition.
fadeslow: A non-linear, temporally decelerated (eased) fade transition.
hlwind: A horizontal wind-like pixel dispersion effect sweeping from the left.
hrwind: A horizontal wind-like pixel dispersion effect sweeping from the right.
vuwind: A vertical wind-like pixel dispersion effect sweeping upwards.
vdwind: A vertical wind-like pixel dispersion effect sweeping downwards.
coverleft: The incoming shot completely covers the outgoing shot by moving leftwards.
coverright: The incoming shot covers the outgoing shot by moving rightwards.
coverup: The incoming shot covers the outgoing shot by moving upwards.
coverdown: The incoming shot covers the outgoing shot by moving downwards.
revealleft: The outgoing shot continuously slides left to reveal the underlying incoming shot.
revealright: The outgoing shot slides right to reveal the incoming shot.
revealup: The outgoing shot slides up to reveal the incoming shot.
revealdown: The outgoing shot slides down to reveal the incoming shot.
